Subject: Payment notice - wire sent, please confirm allocation

Hi Neha,

We wired EUR 126,540.00 to Redwood's account yesterday (20-Mar). Our payment reference is BRL4521-WIRE. The transfer shows as one-line payment for the net amount but our bank didn't include invoice references for the two invoice lines (Invoice 4521 for EUR 96,540 and Invoice 4522 for EUR 30,000 VAT reverse charge).

Can you confirm which invoice(s) this landed against? Our AP system shows it as a single single-line payment and we need a statement or evidence to reconcile on our side. Also request: we need a VAT-detailed allocation if Redwood applied any VAT handling (we flagged Invoice 4522 as reverse-charge).

I attached the bank SWIFT confirmation and our remittance CSV extract. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if helpful.

Thanks,

Emma —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the SWIFT and statement. I started an internal trace with finance to confirm allocation. Quick summary of next steps from our side:

- I'll ask Finance (cc'd) to confirm ledger posting and whether the payment cleared as a single unapplied receipt or was applied to Invoice 4521 (the larger line).
- If it was misapplied, Finance will re-apply and issue a corrected statement and VAT breakdown.
- Please send any remittance CSVs or payment references from your bank window in the next 24 hours if available; that speeds reconciliation.

Can you confirm the exact value date your bank shows on the SWIFT? I see the payment timestamp but want to line up value dates for VAT period cutoffs.

I'll escalate for priority handling — this looks like it will block your close if not resolved quickly.

Best,

I pulled the ledger and the payment did post yesterday to an unapplied cash suspense account (8600-SUSP). The incoming reference BRL4521-WIRE did not match our cash application rules because the remittance reference was absent in the transaction description.

Action items from finance:
- Rishi will re-open the cash application and manually match against Invoice 4521 (EUR 96,540).
- The remaining EUR 30,000 will be left as a separate unapplied item pending AP confirmation of reverse-charge handling for Invoice 4522.
- We will generate a corrected statement of account showing both invoices and explicit VAT treatment lines, plus a VAT credit memo if necessary.

I will attach the provisional statement and mark the ticket urgent. ETA for corrected statement and VAT breakdown: EOD today.
